[element-fpage]
=== `<fpage>` First Page (in a citation)

Page number on which a document begins, typically used as part of citing a journal article or referencing a related journal article.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>>
* <<attribute-seq,`@seq`>>
* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>, <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>>, <<element-nlm-citation,`<nlm-citation>`>>, <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>, <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>
#### Description

Text, numbers, or special characters
#### Content Model

[source,xml]
